WHO WE ARE

We’re not in the wing business. We’re in the flavor business. It’s been our mission to Serve the World Flavor since we first opened in 1994, and we’re just getting started. 1997 saw the opening of our first brand partner operated Wingstop location, and by 2002 we had served the world one billion wings. It’s flavor that defines us and has made Wingstop one of the fastest growing brands in the restaurant industry.

Above all else – our success is largely due to our people and our core values, or what we call The Wingstop Way of being entrepreneurial, service-minded, fun, and authentic. We believe having a strong people foundation centered on these collective values creates a crave-worthy culture and talented team, as well as ensures our brand is poised for accelerated growth. We all win together.

WHAT WE'LL NEED

We’re not in the wing business. We’re in the flavor business. Our mission is to Serve the World Flavor by building a best-in-class restaurant system powered by strong operators, disciplined execution, and consistent guest experiences.

Our franchise system is the engine of our growth. The field organization plays a critical role in ensuring that every restaurant operates with clarity, consistency, and accountability.

The Franchise Business Consultant I (FBC I) is the frontline field operator responsible for driving execution across a portfolio of franchised Wingstop restaurants.

This role serves as the primary business partner to Brand Partners, ensuring:

  • Consistent execution of operating standards
  • Clear visibility into business performance
  • Disciplined routines that drive accountability
  • Timely identification and resolution of performance gaps

This is not a coordination role.

This is a performance execution role focused on improving how the business runs day-to-day.

Performance Execution and Visibility

  • Monitor Same Store Sales, guest experience metrics, and operational KPIs
  • Identify performance gaps and implement structured improvement plans
  • Establish and maintain disciplined business routines, including:
    • Weekly performance check-ins
    • Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs)
  • Drive follow-through on commitments and ensure accountability
  • Maintain clear and consistent visibility into restaurant performance

Operating Standards and Brand Discipline

  • Ensure execution of brand standards across:
    • Speed
    • Accuracy
    • Hospitality
    • Food quality
  • Reinforce compliance with franchise agreements and operational expectations
  • Drive adoption and execution of enterprise initiatives, including:
    • Loyalty programs
    • SmartKitchen
    • Training platforms
  • Protect the brand across food safety, operations, and guest experience

Franchise Partnership and Influence

  • Build strong, trust-based relationships with Brand Partners
  • Influence performance through operational expertise and clear communication
  • Deliver direct, actionable feedback aligned to business results
  • Hold partners accountable to agreed-upon actions and commitments
  • Escalate performance or compliance issues when necessary

Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Partner with cross-functional teams, including:
    • Development
    • Marketing
    • Training
    • Supply Chain
    • Finance
    • Technology
  • Support new restaurant openings and ensure operational readiness
  • Provide field-based insights to inform enterprise decision-making

What Success Looks Like

  • Sustained improvement in Same Store Sales across portfolio
  • Reduced variability between high- and low-performing restaurants
  • Consistent execution of brand standards
  • Strong adoption and execution of enterprise initiatives
  • Effective QBR cadence and structured business routines
  • Clear accountability and follow-through from Brand Partners

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • 4–7 years of multi-unit restaurant operations experience, preferably in a franchise environment
  • Strong operational expertise with the ability to diagnose and resolve performance issues
  • Financial acumen with ability to interpret restaurant-level metrics and trends
  • Proven ability to influence without direct authority
  • Strong organizational and prioritization skills
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Willingness to travel extensively within assigned region
  • Although this role is remote, we do need this candidate to reside in San Francisco or the greater Bay Area.

WHO YOU ARE

No job is too small. You recognize that the real work happens in the restaurants, and everything we do should support their success. You stay humble, roll up your sleeves, and always look for ways to help. You learn from others and contribute wherever you can.

You care deeply about doing great work and driving results. You’re curious, ask questions, and seek out opportunities to improve. You don’t just point out problems—you bring solutions, ideas, and perspectives that move the team forward.

You take full responsibility for your work and see things through to completion. You aren’t afraid to fail because you know that failure is a part of learning and growth. You take action, move fast, and keep pushing forward.

You lead with empathy, respect, and emotional intelligence. You collaborate effectively, fostering a culture of trust and constructive feedback. You understand the importance of teamwork and ensure that your actions build others up rather than break them down.

You push yourself and others to be better. You embrace healthy conflict, knowing that great ideas and strong teams emerge from honest, constructive conversations. You believe that leaders create leaders and are committed to fostering a culture of growth, challenge, and continuous improvement.

BENEFITS

  • Unlimited paid time off for exempt employees

  • One paid volunteer day of your choice

  • Competitive bonus structure for eligible roles

  • Team member stock purchase plan

  • Health savings or flexible spending account options

  • 401k – (dollar for dollar on the first 3% and then 50 cents on the dollar for the next 2% for team member contributions up to 5% of eligible compensation)

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits

  • Basic life and AD&D insurance provided

  • Pet insurance

  • Education Assistance

  • Wellness reimbursement program

  • Paid maternity and paternity leave

Fun is the best Flavor:

  • Discount on Wingstop gift cards

A note from the founder

Most professional services firms are still treating TikTok, Reels, and Shorts as a place where their interns post stock-footage memes.

That is not a brand. That is filler.

The firms that win the next decade on social are the ones that put real voices in front of real cameras and ship at cadence. We are looking for original video creators who can build TWF's short-form presence on TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.

This is a performance role with a clear climb. Lower starter rates. Real upside on view milestones.

What you would do

  • Produce 4-6 original short-form videos per week (60-90 sec, vertical, captioned)
  • Concept, shoot (often using TWF-supplied raw or self-recorded), edit, caption, publish
  • Originals - not clips. You build the narrative from scratch.
  • Themes: workforce strategy, hospitality industry commentary, behavioral health workforce, founder reflection, MBE business building
  • Coordinate publishing schedule with Social Media Manager
  • Track view performance and iterate

Compensation - Climbing Ladder

Stage 1 (first 90 days, mission-aligned starter rate):

  • $20 per approved video
  • $3 per 1,000 views above 500 baseline
  • $30 milestone bonus per video that crosses 10,000 views

Stage 2 (after 25 approved videos + sustained traction):

  • $35 per approved video
  • $5 per 1,000 views
  • $75 milestone at 10,000 views

Stage 3 (after 6 months + channel scale gate):

  • $50 per approved video
  • $5 per 1,000 views
  • $150 milestone at 10,000 views
  • $750 milestone at 100,000 views
  • Revenue share % on any sponsorship traced to your content
  • Senior advisor track opens

Who we want

  • 1-5 years producing short-form video (TikTok, Reels, Shorts)
  • Comfortable on camera OR strong direction skills for talent who is
  • Caption fluency, lower-third design instinct
  • Sharp narrative instinct, brand-voice respect
  • Self-directed, weekly cadence reliability

Bonus: Background in B2B services, professional content, healthcare, hospitality, or government services.

Who we are not for

  • Editors only (we need creators, not just cutters)
  • Creators who only ship aesthetic without strategic substance
  • Anyone who needs weekly check-ins on creative direction

Before our conversation - take a look at the firm

  • HR Advisory practice:

How to start the conversation

Email:
line: Short-Form Video Creator - [Your Name]

In your note, send:

  1. Your portfolio - 3-5 videos you have made
  2. Your highest single-video view number
  3. The platforms you focus on (TikTok, Reels, Shorts)

We respond within 48 hours. We do not ghost.

Users reach the Service Desk when the AI-driven Tier 0 self-service portal and chatbot have not resolved their issue, so the analyst's core work is judgment: determining what is actually wrong, how much it matters to the mission, what priority it warrants, whether it can be resolved at Tier I or deflected to self-service, and when and where it must be escalated. The analyst also improves the system itself by identifying knowledge and automation gaps and drafting content that shifts work to Tier 0. Performance is measured on First Contact Resolution, SLA adherence, and customer experience scores. This is a salaried, FLSA-exempt position in which you will independently analyze situations, determine the appropriate course of action, and exercise discretion and independent judgment on matters of significance to the program and its customers.

THIS IS A REMOTE ROLE WITH UP TO 10% OF TRAVEL INVOLVED.

JOB DUTIES:

  • Analyze incoming incidents and service requests from internal users across phone, chat, email, and portal channels to determine the nature, scope, and business impact of each issue, and independently assign the appropriate Priority Level (PL1 through PL4) and category in the enterprise ITSM platform (e.g., ServiceNow).
  • Determine the appropriate resolution approach for each Tier I issue by evaluating symptoms against known errors, knowledge articles, and system behavior, and decide when an issue can be resolved at Tier I, deflected to self-service, or must be escalated to Tier II, Tier III, or a specialized resolver group.
  • Resolve account, access, connectivity, and application issues by selecting and applying the correct diagnostic and remediation steps, including administrative actions on user accounts and configurations within delegated authority.
  • Evaluate whether resolution actions have fully addressed the customer's need before placing tickets in "Resolved - Awaiting Customer Confirmation" status under the Customer-Confirmed Ticket Closure process, and document resolutions clearly for reuse by other analysts.
  • Assess the age and risk of items in the open ticket queue, decide which require follow-up with users or resolver groups, and take action to prevent tickets from breaching resolution SLAs.
  • Identify gaps and inaccuracies in knowledge articles and Virtual Agent (chatbot) content encountered during resolution and draft recommended new or revised content to improve Tier 0 deflection and First Contact Resolution.
  • Draft plain-language situational awareness alerts that state impact, required user actions, and expected time to resolution for Government pre-approval, and recommend when an emerging pattern of contacts warrants an alert.
  • Contribute observations on incident trends and escalation drivers to Proactive Problem Management, and support execution of customer satisfaction surveys and the collection of CSAT and Customer Effort Score data.

Qualifications

REQUIREMENTS:

  • Bachelor's degree and 0 years of related experience (an Associate's degree with 2 years of related experience, or 4 years of related experience in lieu of a degree, may be substituted).
  • Must be a U.S. Citizen.
  • Must have an Active Secret Clearance (favorably adjudicated T3/T3R) to start.
  • Must be willing and able to obtain TS/SCI eligibility after start, if required by mission needs.
  • Must be within investigation scope and/or currently enrolled in Continuous Evaluation / Continuous Vetting.
  • Must possess and maintain a current DoD 8570/8140 IAT Level I baseline certification (e.g., CompTIA A+ CE, Network+ CE, Security+ CE, CCNA-Security, or SSCP) prior to performing cybersecurity-related duties.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently, analyze problems, determine the appropriate course of action, and exercise discretion and independent judgment with limited day-to-day supervision.
  • Experience or demonstrated aptitude in help desk, service desk, call center, desktop support, or customer technical support.
  • Working knowledge of Windows 10/11, Microsoft 365 applications, Active Directory account concepts, basic networking (Wi-Fi, VPN, IP connectivity), and common peripherals.
  • Familiarity with ticketing systems and service desk workflows, including accurate ticket documentation and escalation.
  • Ability to work assigned shifts within a 6:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. ET core schedule, and willingness to work extended-hours shifts (evenings, overnight, weekends, and holidays) if assigned to the extended-hours team.
  • Strong customer service orientation, patience, and the ability to communicate clearly with non-technical users by phone and in writing.
  • Ability to follow documented procedures precisely while handling a high volume of contacts in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to work a fixed or rotating extended-hours schedule (weeknights 8:01 p.m. to 5:59 a.m. ET and/or weekends 12:00 a.m. to 11:59 p.m. ET), including Federal holidays; this position primarily works remotely.

DESIRED SKILLS:

  • HDI Customer Service Representative, HDI Support Center Analyst, or ITIL 4 Foundation certification.
  • Experience using ServiceNow (incident, request, knowledge, CMDB, Service Catalog, Virtual Agent) or a comparable enterprise ITSM platform.
  • Experience working across multiple security enclaves (NIPRNet, SIPRNet, JWICS) and with classified system handling procedures.
  • Familiarity with customer experience (CX) measurement, including CSAT, Customer Effort Score (CES), and experience level agreements (XLAs).
  • Experience supporting Department of War (DoW), DoD, or other compliance-driven Federal IT environments.
  • Familiarity with remote support tools, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, and mobile device basics.
  • Interest in growing into Tier II desktop support, systems administration, or cybersecurity roles.

raw.description:
Overview

This position is responsible for protecting Bio-Rad’s data and cloud estate and for leading high-severity security incident response outside US hours. The role owns the enterprise Data Loss Prevention (DLP) program, responsible for cloud security (AWS and Azure), and acts as the senior escalation point for security alerts in the non-US time zone. The ideal candidate will have a bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security or a closely related subject; an advanced degree is preferred. The position requires strong collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively with IT infrastructure, application teams, business users and managed security service providers.

This position is responsible for protecting Bio-Rad’s data and cloud estate and for leading high-severity security incident response outside US hours. The role owns the enterprise Data Loss Prevention (DLP) program, responsible for cloud security (AWS and Azure), and acts as the senior escalation point for security alerts in the non-US time zone. The ideal candidate will have a bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security or a closely related subject; an advanced degree is preferred. The position requires strong collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively with IT infrastructure, application teams, business users and managed security service providers.

ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own and manage the enterprise Data Loss Prevention (DLP) program end to end – policy design and changes, exception handling, new functionality and rollout – in partnership with Legal and data owners.
  • Define and enforce protection for high-risk company assets by implementing enterprise DLP controls aligned to Legal and regulatory requirements, and maintain a quarterly-reviewed inventory of protected assets with Legal.
  • Reduce Azure/AWS security risk by performing cloud security assessments and remediating all identified findings.
  • Support Azure cloud security engineering work, including Microsoft Graph API automation, secure configuration, and identity and workload hardening.
  • Serve as the security alert lead contact for the non-US time zone for all High and Critical cases, owning end-to-end handling of complex and high-risk incidents through documented closure within SLA.
  • Increase L2 support team’s effectiveness through standardized SOPs, expert guidance, structured escalation support and automation playbooks that shift work left to L2 and reduce escalation volume.
  • Act as integration owner and backup contact for the 3rd party managed detection and response service.
  • Ensure Information Security operations remain compliant with ISO 27001, data privacy regulations and other applicable requirements; support internal audit, FedRAMP and Legal requests.
  • Support Information Security special projects and act as designated backup across key security and GIT domains, building T-shaped skills across the function.
  • Prepare reports, technical presentations and KPI/metrics reporting for management decision-making

Snapshot of the Candidate’s Day: (Describe in a short paragraph, what a day in the life of this role might look like)

  • Reviewing and monitoring security logs for our networks and cloud infrastructure to identify and investigate any potential security threats or vulnerabilities.
  • DLP program – reviewing what the system blocked, tuning policies, and working through exception requests from the business
  • Communicating specific security needs and recommending appropriate security measures.
  • Reviewiong configuration of security tools such as firewalls, intrusion detection systems, and encryption technologies to protect our networks and data.
  • Keeping up-to-date on the latest security threats and technologies.
  • Assessing and testing networks and cloud infrastructure for vulnerabilities and suggesting remediation steps.
  • Reviewing and Auditing Azure and AWS Security Groups to ensure they are configured in a secure and compliant manner.
  • Responding to security incidents and resolve them. Reporting in multiple report formats.
  • Collaborating with other security experts and stakeholders to improve overall security posture.

How the Candidate Will Make an Impact: (Top 5 bullet points outlining the responsibilities and challenges of the role that allow candidates to make impact)

  • Own Bio-Rad’s DLP program and reach full coverage of data labeled Confidential and Restricted, cutting repeat policy violations by improving policies based on what the system actually blocks.
  • Measurably reduce Azure cloud risk by assessing the estate and closing every Critical and High finding within 90 days of identification.
  • Be the escalation point the business relies on outside US hours, leading High and Critical incidents from detection to documented closure within SLA.
  • Make the L2 team materially stronger through SOPs, coaching and automation playbooks that shift work left and reduce escalations.
  • Keep Information Security operations audit-ready against ISO 27001, data privacy regulations and customer commitments.

What the Candidate Brings: (Top 5 required attributes, skills, and work experience)

  • Deep, hands-on data protection experience – enterprise DLP policy design, tuning and exception management, plus data classification and labeling, ideally with Microsoft Purview.
  • Strong Azure cloud security skills – assessment, secure configuration, identity and workload protection, remediation at scale, and automation via Graph API and scripting.
  • Proven incident response leadership at L2 support team with an MSSP or 24x7 SOC, owning High and Critical cases end to end.
  • Excellent judgment and communication – able to explain risk and trade-offs to Legal, business stakeholders and executives, and to write SOPs that others can follow.

Qualifications:

  • Eight (8) or more years of relevant information security experience, including hands-on ownership of an enterprise security program.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Computer Science or a related field; or equivalent work experience required.
  • Demonstrated experience owning an enterprise DLP program – Microsoft Purview DLP and Information Protection preferred – including policy authoring, tuning, exception management and sensitivity labeling of Confidential and Restricted data.
  • Proven experience designing, assessing and remediating Azure cloud security controls (Defender for Cloud, Entra ID, Azure Policy, network and workload security) against compliance and industry best practice; AWS exposure an advantage.
  • Hands-on incident response experience at L2/L3, including ownership of High and Critical cases through closure alongside an MSSP or 24x7 SOC partner, and authorship of SOPs, runbooks and automation/SOAR playbooks. Incident report writing skills.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Graph API and scripting automation (PowerShell, Python) applied to security operations.
  • Knowledge of information security and data privacy laws and frameworks – ISO 27001, GDPR and similar – and experience supporting internal and external audits.
  • Professional certification preferred: CISSP, CCSP, AZ-500, SC-400, GCIH or equivalent.
  • Eight or more years in information security, with working knowledge of ISO 27001 and data privacy requirements, and willingness to cover non-US-hours escalation for global incidents.
  • Strong written and verbal communication; able to work with Legal, business stakeholders and global IT teams, and available to cover High and Critical escalations in the non-US time zone.

Who We Are: For 70 years, Bio-Rad has focused on advancing the discovery process and transforming the fields of science and healthcare. As one of the top five life science companies, we are a global leader in developing, manufacturing, and marketing a broad range of high-quality research and clinical diagnostic products. We help people everywhere live longer, healthier lives. Recently voted a Best Place to Work, Bio-Rad offers a unique employee experience with collaborative teams that span the globe. Here, you are supported by leadership to build your career and are empowered to drive change that makes an impact you can see.

Benefits: Bio-Rad's biggest asset is its people, and the reason why our Total Rewards deliver programs that provide value, quality, and inclusivity while satisfying the diverse needs of our evolving workforce. Our robust offerings serve to enrich the overall health, wealth, and wellbeing of our employees through the various stages of an employee’s work and life cycle. We’re proud to offer a variety of options, including competitive insurance plans for you and your immediate family, Annual Health checkup , Marriage Leave, Paternity Leave ,Employee Assistance Programme , extensive learning and development opportunities, and more.

EEO Statement: Bio-Rad is an Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer, and we welcome candidates of all backgrounds. Veterans, people with disabilities, and people of all races, ethnicities, genders, ages, and orientations are encouraged to apply.

Agency Non-Solicitation: Bio-Rad does not accept agency resumes, unless the agency has been authorized by a Bio-Rad Recruiting Representative. Please do not submit resumes unless authorized to do so. Bio-Rad will not pay for any fees related to unsolicited resume.

raw.excerpt: OverviewRachio is looking for a Director of Product Marketing to own how Rachio decides what to build, how we position it, and how we bring it to market across hardware, software, and subscriptions.
raw.description:
Overview

Rachio is looking for a Director of Product Marketing to own how Rachio decides what to build, how we position it, and how we bring it to market across hardware, software, and subscriptions. This is a senior leader role at Rachio and the owner of our go-to-market (GTM) processes: the mechanism that takes an idea from concept through business case, launch, and post-launch iteration, and helps to surface key debates and to align cross functional teams (across Product, Engineering, Supply Chain, Sales, Support, and Marketing) to a shared set of goals.

The scope spans smart lighting, smart sprinkler and hose controllers, partner and OEM products, and the software and subscription experiences that sit on top of them. It's inherently cross-functional and inherently commercial: you are measured on adoption, revenue, and channel performance, not on the volume of collateral produced. The right person is equally comfortable running a customer research plan, writing a pricing and positioning narrative for the exec team, and sitting in a firmware trade-off conversation with engineering to understand what a feature actually does before deciding how to sell it.

A note on how this role works. Rachio runs a flat organization that maintains a high ownership and fast paced start-up culture. As such, this is a senior individual contributor role. Your influence comes from the quality of your thinking, the clarity of your writing, and your credibility with the people who own the functions you depend on - not from headcount. It has large ownership and depends on your ability to form clear, concise data-driven strategies that earn trust on the team and drive decisions. If you're looking for a role where you set direction and a team executes it, this isn't that role. If you want the leverage of shaping a category-leading portfolio without the overhead of a large org, it is.

Responsibilities

Own the GTM process

  • Build and run the end-to-end GTM process that moves opportunities from ideation to in-market execution, including setting the strategy, collecting feedback, sizing of opportunities, determining key debates and decisions with clear business cases, stage gates, launch readiness, and post-launch review.
  • Set the strategic goals and success criteria for each initiative up front, and drive alignment on them across Product, Engineering, Finance, Operations, Sales, Support, Marketing, and others.
  • Own launch readiness as a mechanism, not a meeting: clear owners, clear dates, clear go/no-go criteria, and an honest retro afterward.
  • Identify where the process itself is the bottleneck and fix it. This role is expected to build repeatable GTM motions and systems that can scale your work across teams.

Be the senior product marketing voice in roadmap and product development

  • Partner with Product Management to shape the roadmap that’s led with data: market sizing, customer research, competitive intelligence, channel input, and knowledgeable ways to leverage AI to organize the data into tangible next steps.
  • Maintain a working understanding of the market: competitive lineups, adjacent smart home platforms and protocols, pro channel dynamics, and where the category is heading.

Positioning, messaging, and pricing

  • Define positioning and messaging architecture for hardware, software, and subscription offerings, and translate technical capability into language customers and pros actually use.
  • Own the single source of truth for each product: positioning, claims, feature availability, competitive comparisons, FAQs, and objection handling.
  • Develop pricing and packaging recommendations in partnership with Product, Sales, and Marketing: good/better/best structures, subscription tiers, channel-specific SKUs, promotional strategy. Each should include financial modeling to support the recommendations.

Launch and channel execution

  • Lead integrated launches across the professional channel, retail, and D2C.
  • Build the enablement that makes the channel effective: support of pro training, distributor and rep materials, retail line reviews, packaging and shelf messaging, product spec and comparison tools.
  • Partner with the Brand Studio and Marketing team to translate positioning into campaigns and measure what they return.
  • Action and close the post-launch feedback loops: what's confusing customers, what's driving returns, what priorities we need to improve CSAT.
  • Lead international expansion opportunities with agency and contractor support where it makes sense.
  • How to size new country expansion and how to build brand awareness in these regions with targeted customer segments.

Voice of the customer and measurement

  • Own the customer research agenda across homeowners and professional installers: qualitative and quantitative, primary and syndicated.
  • Instrument launches so success is measurable: adoption, attach and activation rates, sell-through, ASP, retention, NPS.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 10+ years of product marketing, GTM, or closely related commercial experience, including significant time owning initiatives end-to-end.
  • Comfort operating as a hands-on individual contributor. You write the narrative and docs, build the model, and run the launch yourself rather than assigning it.
  • Demonstrated ownership of a full product lifecycle from concept through launch and iteration, with results you can speak to specifically.
  • Experience marketing connected hardware, consumer electronics, IoT, or technical products, including the realities of long hardware lead times, supply constraints, certification, and channel timing.
  • Experience marketing software or subscription offerings: adoption, attach, retention, and monetization.
  • Track record of driving direction and alignment across product, engineering, finance, operations, and sales without owning those functions.
  • Strong analytical foundation: comfortable building the model, working in spreadsheets and BI tools, and defending the assumptions.
  • Exceptional written communication. Distill a complex set of decisions into a written narrative a leadership team can act on.
  • Bachelor's degree.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States.

DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience building GTM or NPI processes from scratch, or materially rebuilding one that wasn't working.
  • Experience in two-step distribution or professional trade channels (irrigation, landscape, electrical, HVAC, plumbing, building products) alongside retail and D2C.
  • Experience with smart home platforms and protocols: Matter, Thread, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and have enough technical fluency to be useful in engineering conversations.
  • Experience with outdoor products, lighting, water management, or the sustainability categories.
  • Experience with partner, OEM, or co-marketing programs.
  • MBA or advanced degree.

Salary range for candidates based in California: $248,000 - $372,000

Salary range for candidates based in Colorado - New York- New York City or Maryland : $232,000 - $348,000

Salary ranges include base salary and annual incentive bonus if applicable.

Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location.

Rachio is an equal opportunity employer.

raw.description:
Overview

Consilio builds eDiscovery and legal technology solutions used by legal teams at major organizations. Our users make consequential decisions inside our products — often under deadline, always under scrutiny. The work is high-stakes by nature: decisions made inside our products carry legal weight.

We're looking for a Lead UX Designer to own design for critical areas of our product suite and to serve as a steward of our design system. Two things make this role unusual. First, you'll be working out how AI shows up inside these workflows. Second, you'll be setting the standards that hold the experience together across a multi-product portfolio, and governing how those standards get used.

This is an individual contributor role. You will set direction, and you'll have real influence over what gets built.

How this role operates

You'll partner with Product and Engineering early — shaping the problem, not styling a decision that's already been made. You'll prototype fast to explore and align, and work with Engineering to keep design and code in sync.

Our internal design team is small and growing. You'll have more ownership than you'd get at a mature design org, and less existing infrastructure to lean on.

Responsibilities

· Own end-to-end design for one or more product areas, from problem framing through delivery and post-launch iteration

· Partner closely with Product and Engineering to shape solutions early, not just execute on requirements

· Translate in-flight product strategy into journeys, information architecture, and interaction patterns

· Define the interaction models for AI-assisted workflows: how users understand what the system did, why it did it, and how far to trust it

· Evolve and maintain Consilio's design system — defining components and patterns, and setting the standards for how they're used

· Build accessibility standards into the system rather than retrofitting it

· Prototype rapidly to explore, align, and de-risk decisions using modern AI tools

· Lead or partner on user research, and turn findings into decisions other people can act on

· Make the case for design decisions and system standards to senior stakeholders through evidence and clear storytelling

Qualifications

· 8+ years designing complex enterprise or B2B software, with shipped work you can walk us through

· Hands-on experience building and maintaining a design system in a multi-product environment — not just consuming one

· Experience designing end-to-end journeys for multi product ecosystems

· Experience with Figma Make, or other similar prompt-based prototyping tools.

· Depth in interaction design, with visual craft strong enough to make the work persuasive

· Demonstrated experience partnering with Product and Engineering from problem definition forward

· Bachelor’s degree in Design (e.g., Interaction, Visual, Industrial Design), HCI, or equivalent practical experience.

Qualities we're looking for

· Systems thinking. You design for scale and consistency by default, not as a cleanup pass.

· Standards judgment. You know when to generalize a pattern and when a one-off is the right answer — and you can say no to a component request without damaging the relationship.

· Comfort with ambiguity. You can make a defensible tradeoff without perfect information, and revisit it when better information arrives.

· Influence without authority. You change what gets built by being persuasive and well-reasoned, not by escalating.

· Clarity under complexity. You can take a genuinely complicated workflow and make it feel obvious.

Portfolio

· Strong portfolio demonstrating complex workflow design across multiple web-based enterprise products.

· Work samples that showcase prototyping ability.

Nice to have

· Experience with AI driven products or designing AI powered interactions

· Formal or self-directed learning in AI/ML concepts

· Prior experience designing for legal, compliance, healthcare, financial services, or another high-consequence regulated domain.

Consilio’s True North Values

  • Client Experience | Listen for the “why”. Clearly define success. Be accountable. Go the extra distance to create moments that matter.
  • Collaboration | Treat everyone with respect. Welcome diverse views. Partner across geography, generations, and teams. Rally around final decisions.
  • Innovation | Always be curious (ABC). Challenge the status quo. Experiment and fail forward. Build for the future.
  • Grit | Focus on what matters. Work with passion and persistence. Think like an owner. Deliver results you’re proud of.

About Us

Join Our Mission

At Omega Technical Services, every role supports a mission that matters. Whether you're advancing national security, driving innovation in nuclear infrastructure, or supporting critical DOE and DoD operations, you’re part of something bigger here.

Overview

Omega Technical Services is seeking an experienced Designer to support Idaho National Laboratory’s Materials and Fuels Complex. The Designer will translate engineering requirements into detailed drawings, 3D parametric models, assemblies, and technical documentation supporting fabrication and installation.

Qualified candidates will have strong PTC Creo proficiency, precision mechanical design expertise, and hands-on experience applying geometric dimensioning and tolerancing (GD&T). Candidates with mechanical, electrical, or multidisciplinary design backgrounds who meet these qualifications are encouraged to apply.

Work will be performed remotely, with occasional travel onsite to provide support at MFC as needed.

This position is contingent upon contract award and/or project funding. Candidates may be identified, screened, and submitted prior to award. Employment offers and start dates are dependent upon successful contract award, funding authorization, and client approval.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and revise 2D drawings, 3D parametric models, assemblies, and associated documentation using approved engineering inputs.

  • Prepare drawings that clearly define geometry, interfaces, materials, finishes, processes, tolerances, inspection requirements, and assembly relationships.

  • Apply GD&T in accordance with ASME Y14.5-2009, including datum reference frames, feature control frames, material condition modifiers, and basic dimensions.

  • Evaluate tolerance accumulation and fit at part and assembly interfaces to identify potential fabrication, inspection, assembly, or operational issues.

  • Apply sound parametric modeling practices, including fully constrained sketches, stable design intent, controlled references, and organized assembly structures.

  • Independently check drawings and models for accuracy, completeness, fit, form, function, manufacturability, inspectability, and compliance with applicable standards.

  • Verify bills of material, parts lists, item balloons, quantities, drawing references, notes, weld symbols, and revision information.

  • Maintain drawing and model integrity through established document control, revision control, configuration management, and records processes.

  • Resolve technical review comments and maintain an auditable record of changes.

  • Collaborate with engineers, designers, fabricators, and inspectors to clarify requirements and resolve discrepancies.

  • Manage assigned priorities, provide progress updates, and communicate scope, resource, or schedule concerns.

  • Support backlog reduction and mentor drafting personnel when requested.

  • Perform other duties assigned by the BEA Technical Point of Contact.

Education Requirements

  • Bachelor of Science degree from an accredited institution with at least 5 years of relevant experience; OR at least 10 years of relevant experience without a degree.

Qualifications

  • Minimum of 3 years of experience using PTC Creo, with proficiency sufficient to contribute immediately.

  • Demonstrated specialization in precision mechanical design, including 3D parametric modeling, part and assembly detailing, and fabrication drawings.

  • Demonstrated ability to apply GD&T in accordance with ASME Y14.5-2009 and evaluate tolerance accumulation and fit at part and assembly interfaces.

  • Experience independently checking drawings and models for accuracy, completeness, manufacturability, inspectability, and compliance with applicable standards.

  • Ability to interpret engineering specifications, calculations, vendor data, and redlines while preserving engineering intent.

  • Working knowledge of materials, machining, welding, fabrication, inspection, and assembly methods.

  • Experience working within drawing revision control and configuration management processes.

  • Strong problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

  • Ability to work the designated Mountain Time schedule and report onsite at MFC as needed.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience using Windchill or a comparable product data management system, such as PDM or Vault.

  • Working knowledge of AutoCAD.

  • Experience coordinating multidisciplinary drawing packages and resolving comments from engineers, fabricators, and inspectors.

  • Experience mentoring drafting personnel in modeling, detailing, drawing checks, and GD&T application.

  • Experience managing drafting workloads, supporting backlog reduction, and tracking progress against project schedules.

  • Previous DOE/NNSA work experience.

Work Schedule

4/10’s (10 hours/day; four days per week).

Omega Technical Services is a Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business and a trusted partner to the Department of Energy, Department of Defense, and other commercial clients, supporting mission-critical projects that shape national security and technological innovation. Our culture is defined by leadership, initiative, and trust. Our values drive meaningful outcomes and long-term impact.

At Omega Technical Services, you’ll work alongside elite subject matter experts who thrive on being challenged, innovation, and collaboration. We offer competitive pay, comprehensive benefits including medical, dental and vision insurance; short and long term disability insurance; 401(k) with a company match; AD&D insurance, paid time off, and holiday pay. *Based on eligibility requirements.

When you join Omega Technical Services, you’re not just starting a job, you’re building a career that honors the past, powers today’s progress, and accelerates the most vital missions of tomorrow.

Artemis seeks a Change Management Specialist to support the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Veterans Health Administration (VHA) Office of Clinical Informatics (OCI) on the Operational Informatics Pipeline (OIP) contract. Responsibilities

Peraton's Department of the Interior (DOI), U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service (FWS), and NOAA's National Marine Fisheries Service (NMFS) have identified a critical gap in the federal government's ability to conduct comprehensive Endangered Species Act (ESA) research. While FWS operates an authoritative web-based platform for managing data for terrestrial and freshwater species, it does not currently include NMFS marine and anadromous species data forcing agencies to rely on separate, manual processes. This program closes that gap by integrating marine and anadromous species data into the existing FWS platform, creating a single, unified experience for all ESA-listed species.

Peraton is seeking a Senior Technical Architect to support system integration design, technical documentation, and interoperability testing architecture on a federal data migration program. Working closely with the Technical Architect SME, you will lead key technical design activities and serve as a technical reviewer and documentation lead across the project.

This is a fully remote position supporting a 12-month period of performance with potential for follow-on work and possible placement in other programs across Peraton at the conclusion of the program.

Work Location: Remote

  • Extensive experience in systems architecture or technical design on federal IT programs
  • Experience designing API integration architectures and data flow documentation for federal systems
  • Strong knowledge of federal IT governance frameworks and hybrid AWS cloud platform standards
  • Experience with interoperability testing design and technical documentation

Deliver Learning That Develops People and Leaders

Project Manager - Learning & Development (Automotive Industry)

Location: Remote (Full-Time)

Overview

We are seeking an experienced Project Manager, Learning & Development to lead the design, development, and delivery of high-impact leadership, technical, and professional development learning programs within the automotive industry. This role partners closely with instructional designers, learning leaders, subject matter experts, technical trainers, and external vendors to ensure learning solutions are delivered on time, within scope, and aligned with business objectives.

This is an ideal opportunity for a project manager who understands how learning is built, thrives in collaborative environments, and enjoys bringing structure, clarity, and momentum to complex, multi-stakeholder initiatives. Candidates with experience supporting automotive OEMs, EV manufacturers, mobility organizations, dealer networks, manufacturing operations, or technical training programs are highly preferred.

What You'll Do

Lead End-to-End Learning Production

  • Manage the full lifecycle of learning initiatives, including digital, virtual, instructor-led, and technical training programs.

  • Partner with instructional designers, learning program managers, technical trainers, and vendors to bring learning concepts to life.

  • Ensure new learning experiences are delivered on time, within scope, and with consistent quality.

  • Support leadership development, technical capability, compliance, onboarding, and workforce development initiatives.

Plan, Coordinate & Execute

  • Develop and maintain detailed project plans, timelines, dependencies, milestones, and risk logs.

  • Manage multiple concurrent initiatives with overlapping timelines and stakeholders.

  • Facilitate alignment across designers, SMEs, technical experts, vendors, and leadership teams.

  • Monitor project progress, resource allocation, budgets, and critical deliverables.

Stakeholder & Working Group Management

  • Lead working group meetings and design reviews with instructional designers, SMEs, technical experts, and vendors.

  • Ensure requirements are clearly defined and validated prior to design and development.

  • Act as a trusted partner, educating stakeholders on learning design processes and project governance best practices.

  • Provide proactive communication and executive-level project updates.

Quality, Communication & Continuous Improvement

  • Ensure deliverables meet agreed-upon acceptance criteria, instructional standards, and business requirements.

  • Provide regular status updates, surface risks early, and drive issue resolution.

  • Gather feedback, identify opportunities for improvement, and recommend process enhancements.

  • Support production roadmaps, vendor management, resource planning, and budget tracking.

  • Drive continuous improvement across learning development and deployment processes.

What Makes You a Great Fit

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.

  • 5+ years of project or program management experience, preferably supporting learning, training, talent development, or organizational effectiveness initiatives.

  • Experience managing the development and deployment of learning solutions across multiple formats, including:

    • eLearning

    • Video-based learning

    • Virtual instructor-led training

    • Classroom training

    • Technical training programs

    • Simulations, microlearning, and performance support tools

  • Strong ability to manage aggressive timelines with accuracy and attention to detail.

  • Highly organized, able to prioritize effectively, and manage multiple projects simultaneously.

  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity and bringing structure to complex work.

  • Strong consulting mindset with the ability to influence without direct authority.

  • Collaborative, relationship-driven approach to teamwork.

  • Proficiency with project management and collaboration tools such as Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, Jira, Asana, or similar platforms.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Automotive, mobility, EV, manufacturing, industrial, or technical training experience.

  • PMP, Agile, Scrum, or related project management certification.

  • Advanced degree or professional certification in Project Management, Instructional Design, Organizational Development, Learning & Development, or related disciplines.

  • Experience using SAM, Agile, or iterative learning development methodologies.

  • 3+ years of experience in Learning & Development, Talent Development, Training Operations, or a creative studio environment.

  • Experience leading design reviews and working sessions with SMEs and technical experts.

  • Understanding of adult learning principles and instructional design best practices.

  • Experience supporting dealership training, field training, service training, manufacturing training, or workforce development programs.

Why This Role Matters

You will play a key role in shaping learning experiences that develop leaders, strengthen technical capabilities, and support organizational performance across the automotive industry. Your ability to manage complexity, align diverse contributors, and deliver high-quality learning solutions will directly influence workforce readiness, leadership effectiveness, operational excellence, and business success.

If you are passionate about learning, excel at managing complex projects, and want to make a meaningful impact on employee growth and development, we'd love to hear from you.

Overview

BerryDunn is seeking a Senior Consultant with human services policy, program, and compliance experience to join our State Government Practice Group. This role will serve as a Human Services Policy Lead supporting our Guam client and will work closely with the engagement team to help the client strengthen policy, improve operations, and maintain alignment with federal requirements.

As a Senior Consultant, you will bring strong policy research and analysis skills, sound judgment, and the ability to translate complex requirements into practical, client-ready guidance. You will be comfortable working directly with clients, facilitating conversations with diverse stakeholders, and developing high-quality written deliverables that support decision-making, compliance, and program implementation.

In this role, you will provide human services policy subject matter expertise on BerryDunn projects, with an initial focus on our Guam engagement. You will research and interpret federal laws, regulations, and guidance; assess potential impacts to client programs and operations; draft policy and procedure manuals; support federal waiver requests and policy options; and prepare concise client briefs, decision documents, standard operating procedures, implementation materials, and other deliverables. You will work alongside project managers, business analysts, Medicaid policy experts, and implementation leads to helping clients move from policy direction to practical action.

The ideal candidate will have 6+ years of experience working with or for state, territory, or local government agencies responsible for human services programs, such as Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP), Temporary Assistance for Needy Families (TANF), Child Support, Child Care, homelessness services, behavioral health, or related programs. State or territory-level human services policy experience is preferred. The right candidate will be client-focused, collaborative, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in complex public sector environments. Experience with public health programs and policies, business development, proposal writing, and staff development is a plus.

This position may be based in one of BerryDunn’s office locations or remote and will report to the HHS Practice Area Lead Principal. This role will collaborate closely with Guam engagement leadership, the Medicaid policy lead, and cross-functional BerryDunn team members supporting Medicaid, public health, human services, systems, data, process improvement, and implementation workstreams.

Travel Expectations: Travel may range up to 50% depending on client and project needs.

You Will

  • Serve as a human services policy subject matter expert on BerryDunn projects supporting state, territory, and local HHS agency clients
  • Lead the human services policy workstream for the Guam engagement in close coordination with Guam engagement leadership, the Medicaid policy lead, and cross-functional project team members
  • Research, interpret, and summarize federal laws, regulations, and sub-regulatory guidance to identify potential impacts to client programs, operations, policies, and compliance obligations
  • Draft, review, and update policy manuals, procedures, desk guides, job aids, client briefs, and decision documents that translate complex requirements into clear, actionable guidance
  • Assess how federal and territorial policy changes may affect client programs and recommend practical implementation considerations, risks, dependencies, and next steps
  • Support development of federal waiver requests, policy options, standard operating procedures, program implementation plans, training materials, and other client-facing materials
  • Facilitate meetings, interviews, and working sessions with client stakeholders with confidence, professionalism, and a focus on practical outcomes
  • Lead and support project delivery on time and within budget, including managing assigned tasks, supporting staff, and overseeing development of high-quality deliverables
  • Communicate project status, risks, issues, and recommendations clearly to project teams, client leadership, and other stakeholders
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to clients by bringing curiosity, accountability, sound judgment, and a commitment to helping clients solve complex challenges
  • Maintain a strong focus on quality and consistency in accordance with BerryDunn’s Consulting Quality Management Program
  • Contribute to staff development, team learning, and a positive, collaborative, and innovative HHS team culture

You Have

  • A bachelor’s degree in human services, public health, social services, public policy, public administration, or related field
  • 6+ years of experience working with or for state, territory, or local government agencies, preferably in human services or HHS policy, operations, compliance, or implementation
  • Knowledge of human services programs, policies, services, and federal compliance requirements
  • Experience researching and interpreting federal laws, regulations, and guidance and translating findings into client-ready policy recommendations, briefs, manuals, procedures, or implementation materials
  • Strong written communication skills, including the ability to explain complex issues clearly, concisely, and logically for a variety of audiences
  • Strong verbal communication and presentation skills, including the ability to facilitate discussions and communicate recommendations to client and project leadership
  • A client-focused mindset and the ability to build and sustain positive working relationships with staff, clients, and diverse stakeholders
  • Demonstrated ability to lead workstreams, support project teams, and manage competing priorities while delivering quality work on time
  • Strong attention to detail, sound judgment, and the ability to balance immediate project needs with broader program and policy goals
  • Effective project management and organizational skills, including the ability to remain calm, focused, and solutions-oriented during busy or challenging periods
  • Interest in coaching, mentoring, and supporting the development of junior team members
  • Ability and willingness to work Guam business hours as needed to support client meetings, stakeholder engagement, project deadlines, and team collaboration
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools, including PowerPoint, Excel, Word, Project, and Visio

Compensation Details

The base salary range targeted for this role is $80,000 - 135,000. This salary range represents BerryDunn’s good faith and reasonable estimate of the range of possible compensation at the time of posting. If an applicant possesses experience, education, or other qualifications more than the minimum requirements for this posting, that applicant is encouraged to apply, and a final salary range may then be based on those additional qualifications; compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. The salary of the finalist selected for this role will be based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to, years of experience, depth of experience, seniority, merit, education, training, amount of travel, and other relevant business considerations.

Our people are what make BerryDunn special, and in return we strive to support our employees and help them thrive. Eligible employees have access to benefits that go beyond what’s expected to support their physical, mental, career, social, and financial well-being. Visit our website for a complete list of benefits and a look into our culture: Experience BerryDunn.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.

About BerryDunn

BerryDunn is the brand name under which Berry, Dunn, McNeil & Parker, LLC and BDMP Assurance, LLP, independently owned entities, provide services. Since 1974, BerryDunn has helped businesses, nonprofits, and government agencies throughout the US and its territories solve their greatest challenges. Company Overview

At Bridgenext, we engineer Growth Operating Systems. Most enterprises have spent millions on their revenue stack and still aren't seeing the growth they expected.They have tools that function, but no system that wins. We help growth-hungry companies close that gap by turning fragmented platforms, siloed teams, and disconnected data into one integrated Growth OS. More than a technology company or marketing agency, we're a global digital consultancy with experts in engineering, data, AI, creative and more.

Our teams are made up of experts who believe in engineering impact, starting with putting people at the center of everything we do. Every team member directly shapes our work, culture, and values. Nothing matters more to us than a kind, respectful, fulfilling environment that supports everyone. Our flexible, inclusive culture gives you the autonomy, resources, and opportunities to thrive.

Position Description

We are seeking a highly detail-oriented and experienced Senior QA Engineer to join our MedTech team. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the quality, safety, and compliance of our healthcare and medical technology software solutions.

Beyond hands-on manual and automated testing, a critical focus of this role involves rigorous documentation validation, process compliance, and adherence to GxP standards and medical device quality frameworks.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Quality Assurance & Compliance (GxP Focus)
    • Perform thorough validation and review of technical documentation, test plans, requirements trace matrices (RTM), and validation protocols (IQ/OQ/PQ) in accordance with GxP (GCP, GMP, GLP) standards.
    • Ensure all software development and testing activities comply with healthcare regulatory standards (such as FDA 21 CFR Part 11, ISO 13485, IEC 62304, and HIPAA).
    • Participate in regulatory compliance reviews, quality audits, and verification of standard operating procedures (SOPs).
    • Maintain comprehensive audit-ready documentation for all testing phases and defect lifecycles.
  • Manual & Automated Testing
    • Design, develop, and execute end-to-end test strategies, test suites, and test cases for complex MedTech applications.
    • Establish and maintain maintainable, scalable automated test frameworks for API and UI testing (e.g., Cypress, Selenium, Playwright, or Postman).
    • Execute manual functional, non-functional, regression, integration, and risk-based testing where automated testing is not applicable or compliant.
    • Identify, document, prioritize, and track software defects, ensuring root-cause analysis is performed in line with compliance procedures.
  • Collaboration & Leadership
    • Work closely with cross-functional teams including Software Engineers, Product Managers, Regulatory Affairs, and Quality Assurance Managers.
    • Mentor junior QA engineers and advocate for quality-first, compliance-driven engineering practices across the team.
    • Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies while maintaining the necessary balance between agile agility and strict regulatory documentation.

Workplace: Remote / Hybrid role in LATAM, preferably in Argentina

Must Have Skills:

  • Experience: 5+ years of experience as a Quality Assurance Engineer, with a proven track record in both manual and automated testing within regulated environments
  • Domain Knowledge: Solid background in the MedTech, HealthTech, Biotech, or Pharmaceutical industry
  • GxP & Regulatory Expertise: Strong hands-on experience validating documentation and software under GxP guidelines, ISO standards (13485 / 14971), or FDA compliance regulations
  • English Proficiency: Advanced to Fluent English (written and spoken). Seeking level C1/C2 level fluency. Ability to write clear, compliant technical documentation and articulate QA/regulatory concepts effectively to international stakeholders
  • Automation Skills: Proven experience with modern test automation tools/frameworks (e.g., Selenium, Cypress, Playwright) and API testing tools (Postman, REST Assured)
  • Documentation & Traceability: Exceptional skill in writing structured test plans, test cases, execution reports, and maintaining traceability matrices
  • Tools: Experience using issue-tracking and QA management tools such as Jira, TestRail, Zephyr, or similar

Professional Skills:

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
  • Ability to Lead and Guide Discussions with Business Partners
  • Confident and Proactive Nature
  • Ability to understand scope and ask the right questions
  • Organized, detail and process oriented
  • Proven ability to build, manage and foster a team-oriented environment

raw.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Argano's Business Consulting practice partners with organizations to design, optimize, and transform how work gets done — connecting strategy to execution by ensuring the people side of change is never an afterthought. As a Lead OCM Consultant, you will own the change management workstream on complex client engagements, leading the strategies, plans, and interventions that drive real adoption and help people move through change successfully.

This is a senior practitioner role — not a project coordinator. You will work directly with executives and senior leaders, coaching them to play their sponsorship roles effectively. You will design and execute stakeholder engagement plans, impact assessments, communications strategies, and training frameworks. You will also serve as a subject matter authority within Argano's community of practice, developing colleagues and contributing to the methodologies that define how we deliver OCM.

Typical engagements include ERP and enterprise technology implementations, operating model redesigns, organizational restructuring, process transformation programs, and post-merger integration — across a range of industries and client environments. You will work across one or more concurrent engagements at any given time.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Engagement Planning & Delivery

▸ Partner with Engagement and Project Managers to translate high-level plans into detailed OCM workplans and inventories of required deliverables — ensuring the change management workstream is integrated, sequenced, and resourced from day one

▸ Apply Argano's LIFT delivery methodology and incorporate key learnings from prior engagements to build change strategies uniquely fitted to each client situation

▸ Establish strong working relationships with client business leaders, project sponsors, and functional stakeholders — building trust that makes OCM work possible

▸ Work across one or more concurrent projects at one or more clients — maintaining quality, pace, and stakeholder confidence throughout

Change Strategy & Stakeholder Engagement

▸ Lead the design and execution of change management strategies and plans that maximize employee adoption, minimize resistance, and accelerate time to proficiency

▸ Conduct change impact assessments across affected roles, processes, systems, and organizational structures — translating findings into targeted intervention plans

▸ Develop and maintain stakeholder analysis and engagement plans — identifying change champions, resistance risks, and influence strategies by group

▸ Help clients understand and articulate the value of investing in the people side of change, including changes to business processes, systems and technology, job roles, and organizational structures

▸ Identify and assess organizational readiness for change throughout the engagement — surfacing risks early and adjusting the plan accordingly

Executive Coaching & Sponsorship

▸ Act as a trusted advisor and coach for senior leaders and executives, helping them understand and fulfill their role as active, visible change sponsors

▸ Prepare leaders to communicate change effectively — providing messaging frameworks, talking points, and facilitation support for key leadership moments

▸ Build leadership alignment and engagement around the change — helping executives model the behaviors the organization needs to see

▸ Navigate organizational politics and resistance at the leadership level with maturity and credibility

Communications

▸ Design and execute end-to-end communications strategies that reach the right audiences with the right message at the right time

▸ Develop communications plans, calendars, and content — from executive announcements to front-line manager briefings to system-user notifications

▸ Write, review, and refine communications across multiple channels — email, town halls, intranet, video, and manager talking points

▸ Measure communication effectiveness and adjust approach based on audience feedback and engagement signals

Training & Enablement

▸ Provide input to the design and development of training strategies, approaches, and programs aligned to the change and the affected audience groups

▸ Define training needs by role and persona — ensuring training content addresses both the 'how' of the new system or process and the 'why' of the change

▸ Support the design, development, and delivery of training programs in collaboration with instructional designers, subject matter experts, and technology teams

▸ Develop or support the development of job aids, quick reference guides, and sustainment tools that support adoption beyond the initial training event

Practice Development & Capability Building

▸ Actively contribute to the development and continuous refinement of Argano's OCM methodologies, tools, templates, and accelerators

▸ Lead and champion a defined set of OCM leading-practice capabilities within the community of practice — teaching and enabling colleagues to deploy them effectively on client engagements

▸ Mentor junior OCM practitioners and analysts through direct project collaboration and structured coaching

Business Development

▸ Build trusted relationships with client leaders that generate expansion opportunities and long-term partnerships

▸ Contribute to proposals and business development pursuits by bringing OCM expertise, scope definition capability, and a track record of measurable adoption outcomes

▸ Participate in thought leadership and knowledge-sharing activities that strengthen Argano's market position in OCM

Travel
Up to 50% travel to client sites, depending on project phase and engagement requirements — typically higher during assessment, design workshops, and go-live support phases

QUALIFICATIONS

Education

▸ Bachelor’s degree preferred; psychology, organizational behavior, communications, business, or HR disciplines are strong fits

▸ Advanced degree (MBA, MS in Organizational Development, I/O Psychology, or related field) is an advantage

▸ Prosci ADKAR certification or equivalent change management certification is strongly preferred

▸ Additional relevant credentials — CCMP, Kotter, LaMarsh, or similar — are valued

Required Experience

▸ 5+ years of hands-on organizational change management experience on complex, enterprise-scale transformation programs

▸ Demonstrated end-to-end OCM delivery capability — from change strategy through stakeholder engagement, communications, training, and sustainment

▸ Proven experience working directly with senior executives as an OCM coach and advisor — not just as a communications or training executor

▸ Solid understanding of how people go through change — the psychology, the resistance patterns, the adoption curve, and what actually moves people from awareness to commitment

▸ Demonstrated ability to build and maintain strong relationships across all levels of an organization, from front-line employees to C-suite executives

▸ Experience on large-scale organizational change efforts — enterprise technology implementations, process transformation, restructuring, or post-merger integration

▸ Strong written and verbal communication skills — ability to craft clear, compelling, audience-appropriate messaging and to present confidently to senior stakeholders

▸ Ability to influence without formal authority, navigate ambiguity, and move diverse groups of stakeholders toward a common goal.

Preferred Experience

▸ Experience delivering OCM on enterprise technology implementations — system agnostic (ERP, HCM, CRM, SCM, or other platforms)

▸ Familiarity with instructional design principles and adult learning theory — ability to contribute meaningfully to training design conversations

▸ Experience with stakeholder analysis and engagement tools, change readiness assessments, and resistance management frameworks

▸ Background working across multiple industries — manufacturing, consumer goods, financial services, life sciences, retail, or public sector preferred

▸ Experience managing or leading a small OCM team or workstream (4+ people)

▸ Comfort working in environments where the OCM methodology needs to be built, not just applied — able to design the approach, not just follow a playbook


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Beyond the qualifications, we are looking for someone who:

▸ Leads with empathy — genuinely understands what it feels like to be on the receiving end of change, and designs interventions with real human experience in mind

▸ Earns credibility fast — can walk into a room of skeptical executives and quickly establish the trust and authority needed to coach effectively

▸ Communicates with precision — knows that the right message, to the right audience, at the right moment is what moves people, and designs every communication with that in mind

▸ Operates as a strategic partner, not a support function — understands the business objectives driving the change and connects OCM activities directly to those outcomes

▸ Is comfortable with ambiguity and resistance — doesn't need perfect conditions to do good work, and doesn't take resistance personally

▸ Develops others — genuinely invested in making junior practitioners better, and in building a stronger OCM practice at Argano

    • Developing health and human services programs with home and community based services (HCBS) focused on children, youth, and families

    • Supporting skills such as stakeholder engagement, research, and meeting facilitation

Our people are what make BerryDunn special, and in return we strive to support our employees and help them thrive. We will ensure that individuals are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process or perform essential job functions. Please contact to request an accommodation.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.

BerryDunn is the brand name under which Berry, Dunn, McNeil & Parker, LLC and BDMP Assurance, LLP, independently owned entities, provide services. Since 1974, BerryDunn has helped businesses, nonprofits, and government agencies throughout the US and its territories solve their greatest challenges. The firm’s tax, advisory, and consulting services are provided by Berry, Dunn, McNeil & Parker, LLC, and its attest services are provided by BDMP Assurance, LLP, a licensed CPA firm.
